    for p in app.data.dataProjects:
        pass

        prod = products.item(i)

    print("Products:", out)
    return None

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    # Bounding box
    bb = root.boundingBox
    print("BBox min:", [round(v*10,3) for v in (bb.minPoint.x,bb.minPoint.y,bb.minPoint.z)])

    # Bodies
    for b in root.bRepBodies:
        bbb = b.boundingBox
        print("Body:", b.name,
              "min", [round(v*10,3) for v in (bbb.minPoint.x,bbb.minPoint.y,bbb.minPoint.z)],
              "max", [round(v*10,3) for v in (bbb.maxPoint.x,bbb.maxPoint.y,bbb.maxPoint.z)])
    # Faces summary
    print("Face count:", sum(b.faces.count for b in root.bRepBodies))
    return None

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    b = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    # Group planar faces by normal direction and coordinate
    from collections import defaultdict
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for f in b.faces:
        g = f.geometry
        if isinstance(g, adsk.core.Plane):
            n = g.normal
            key = (round(n.x,2),round(n.y,2),round(n.z,2))
            # a point on plane
            pt = f.pointOnFace
            # signed offset
            groups[key].append((round(f.area*100,1),
                                round(pt.x*10,2),round(pt.y*10,2),round(pt.z*10,2)))
    for k in sorted(groups.keys()):
        print("normal", k, "-> faces:")
        for v in sorted(groups[k]):
            print("    area(mm2)",v[0]," pt(x,y,z)",v[1],v[2],v[3])
    return None

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    setup = cam.setups.item(0)
    # Inspect setup parameters
    for p in setup.parameters:
        try:
            v = p.expression
        except:
            v = p.value.value if p.value else None
        print(p.name, "=", v)
    return None

    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    camMgr = adsk.cam.CAMManager.get()
    libMgr = camMgr.libraryManager
    toolLibs = libMgr.toolLibraries
    # Find TIW library
    def walk(url, depth=0):
        found=[]
        for child in toolLibs.childAssetURLs(url):
            found.append(child.toString())
        return found
    roots = [toolLibs.urlByLocation(adsk.cam.LibraryLocations.LocalLibraryLocation),
             toolLibs.urlByLocation(adsk.cam.LibraryLocations.Fusion360LibraryLocation)]
    for r in roots:
        print("ROOT", r.toString())
        for c in toolLibs.childAssetURLs(r):
            print("  ", c.toString())
    return None

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    camMgr = adsk.cam.CAMManager.get()
    toolLibs = camMgr.libraryManager.toolLibraries
    url = toolLibs.urlByLocation(adsk.cam.LibraryLocations.LocalLibraryLocation)
    for c in toolLibs.childAssetURLs(url):
        if 'TIW' in c.toString():
            lib = toolLibs.toolLibraryAtURL(c)
            print("Library:", c.toString(), "tools:", lib.count)
            for i in range(lib.count):
                t = lib.item(i)
                p = t.parameters
                def g(n):
                    try: return p.itemByName(n).value.value
                    except: return None
                tp = t.parameters.itemByName('tool_type').value.value if p.itemByName('tool_type') else '?'
                dia = g('tool_diameter')
                flutes = g('tool_numberOfFlutes')
                desc = g('tool_description')
                print(i, "| #", g('tool_number'), "|", tp, "| dia", dia, "| flutes", flutes, "|", desc)
    return None

    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    setup = cam.setups.item(0)

    ops = adsk.core.ObjectCollection.create()
    for o in setup.operations:
        ops.add(o)

    while not future.isGenerationCompleted:
        time.sleep(0.5)
    for o in setup.operations:

    return None
